purpose: A4 uses A3/A2 definitions first. Existing graph providers are conditional on exact references to existing reusable assets; no target code or destination is required for planned new development.

binding.input_target: A3.target_ref (canonical); A2.target_ref must match A3.declared_target_hint or A3.target_ref
binding.query_only_after: Optional exact inventory reference for a preexisting reusable/affected asset, not necessarily a target implementation
binding.no_matched_inventory_object: PLANNED_BUILD_WITH_UNVERIFIED_EXISTING_IMPACT when change intent is a new build; otherwise IMPACT_UNKNOWN. Never block code creation solely because there is no target path.
binding.version_and_currentness: Host revalidates exact A3 source_refs/currentness; A4 never self-attests.

sources.lookup: EXACT object_ref supplied through authorized A3->inventory binding
sources.lookup_policy: Exact object_ref from authorized binding only; no target-code destination required in PLANNED_BUILD
sources.required_for: EXISTING_CHANGE or preexisting reusable asset graph impact only
An existing inventory object with exact reference, never a planned target
An existing inventory object with exact reference, never a planned target

exception: Planned target with no code path uses A3-approved obligations, no graph lookup or invented destination. Unknown dependency/cross-system impact is explicit and scoped; A8 can return only to the material missing source.
security: Existing governed host acquires reads; no SQL/network inside A4
Do not conflate policy VIGENTE with code implemented/deployed
No new impact engine; same shared core as TST-05
Readback is not independent attestation or A4 operational approval

PLANNED_BUILD.trigger: Explicit A2 operation CREATE, IMPLEMENT or BUILD_NEW; an unverified intention, not proof that no code exists
PLANNED_BUILD.direct_output: CREATION obligations on new target, each with change_action=CREATE and source definition_action=REUSE; A2 intent is unverified, not authority to create
PLANNED_BUILD.excluded: Pending/candidate definitions and policy-dependent rules without approved binding
PLANNED_BUILD.existing_dependencies: No source-qualified existing asset => UNKNOWN, not NO_IMPACT
PLANNED_BUILD.source_research: Only targeted A3 readback if a material decision can change

EXISTING_CHANGE.trigger: Exact target or affected existing asset bound to inventory.object_ref
EXISTING_CHANGE.expected_item_change_action: UNKNOWN without exact per-item before/after evidence

item_action_rules.PLANNED_BUILD: Source rule/field existing => definition_action=REUSE; new target screen obligation => change_action=CREATE; never claim existing policy is created
item_action_rules.EXISTING_CHANGE: Graph edges imply POSSIBLE_IMPACT, not item change; change_action=UNKNOWN until exact item-level delta is provided
item_action_rules.DELETE: Requires explicit A2 intent and target authority; does not execute deletion
item_action_rules.REPLACE: Requires explicit A2 intent and comparison of old/new; no inferred replacement from missing path
item_action_rules.REUSE: No code mutation; only claim REUSE_AS_IS/NO_CHANGE if exact currentness and parity independently evidenced
item_action_rules.NO_CHANGE: Cannot be concluded from a zero-row impact graph
